question: What choice did Nebuzaradan give Jeremiah?
options: Come to Babylon, or go wherever he pleased
Serve in the army or go to prison
Live in Egypt or in Moab
Become a priest or a scribe
explanation: Nebuzaradan said, "Come with me to Babylon, if you like, and I will look after you; but if you do not want to, then don't come… go wherever you please."
